svg.title: Different conclusions need their own evidence
svg.desc: These are evidence questions, not an inevitable attack sequence. Events may overlap, be absent or remain unconfirmed. Contact: Texts and call records show signs of contact, not necessarily the caller's true identity. Credential exposure: An employee reports sharing an OTP. This creates exposure risk requiring timely protective action. Successful authentication: Platform records still need checks of the operator and authorization; success alone does not identify an attacker. Unauthorized action: Verify the operator, purpose, permissions and actual activity using access or change records. Data exfiltration: Verified transfer evidence must establish content, recipient and scope. A download alert alone is insufficient.
